name: B10-0177/2024 (ECR) – Recommendation on smoke- and aerosol-free environments
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Council’s recommendation on smoke- and aerosol-free environments
part_text:
The European Parliament is giving its opinion on the Council's plan to make more public places smoke- and aerosol-free. It supports protecting people from unwanted smoke, especially children and pregnant women outdoors. But it says the plan should treat e-cigarettes and heated tobacco differently from normal cigarettes, because these may help smokers quit. It also criticises the Commission for not checking the plan's economic impact, especially on hotels, restaurants and cafés.

- The Parliament asks for rules that treat e-cigarettes and heated tobacco separately from normal cigarettes.
- It affects smokers, vapers, children, pregnant women, and hotels, restaurants and cafés.
- The Commission must report back in four years on how the plan worked.
